dataDbRecovery.title: Repair vault database
dataDbRecovery.message: Memry's database for this vault is damaged.
dataDbRecovery.detail: Your notes and journal files are not affected. Repair keeps the damaged database as a backup at {path}, starts a fresh one, rebuilds what it can from your vault files, and restores synced items on the next sync. Changes that had not synced yet are recovered where possible.

obsidianVault.title: Open Obsidian vault
obsidianVault.message: Open a copy of this Obsidian vault?
obsidianVault.detail:
Opening an Obsidian vault in memrynote can lose data your Obsidian plugins rely on. When memrynote turns a plugin's task line into a task, it rewrites the line. Fields such as the Tasks plugin's due dates leave the file, and Obsidian no longer sees them.

memrynote can copy “{name}” to “{copyName}” next to it and open the copy. “{name}” stays exactly as it is.
obsidianVault.detailExistingCopy:
Opening an Obsidian vault in memrynote can lose data your Obsidian plugins rely on. When memrynote turns a plugin's task line into a task, it rewrites the line. Fields such as the Tasks plugin's due dates leave the file, and Obsidian no longer sees them.

A memrynote copy, “{copyName}”, is already next to it. memrynote can open that copy. “{name}” stays exactly as it is.

error.reminderTimeMustBeFuture: Reminder time must be in the future
error.updateReadOnlyVolume: Updates can't be installed while memrynote runs from this location. Move memrynote to your Applications folder and open it again.

installingUpdate.title: Installing update…
installingUpdate.subtitle: MemryNote will reopen automatically.
installingUpdate.subtitleOpenAgain: Open MemryNote again in a moment.

webview2Missing.title: MemryNote can't start
webview2Missing.body:
MemryNote needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime to show its window, and this computer doesn't have it. Download the installer from Microsoft ({url}), run it, then reopen MemryNote.

Open the download page now?
webview2Missing.bodyInstallFailed:
MemryNote needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime to show its window, and installing it didn't work. Download the installer from Microsoft ({url}), run it, then reopen MemryNote.

Open the download page now?

webview2Installing.body: MemryNote is installing the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime it needs to show its window. This can take up to two minutes.

failed.title: MemryNote couldn't finish starting
failed.body: This can happen when the disk is very low on free space, or with older graphics drivers. Try freeing up some disk space, then reopen MemryNote. If it keeps happening, reinstalling usually clears it.

crashed.title: MemryNote stopped working
crashed.body: The page kept stopping, so MemryNote stopped reloading it. Close this window to quit, then reopen MemryNote. If it keeps happening, reinstalling usually clears it.
crashed.details: The page process ended {count} times in a minute ({reason}).

startup.reloaded: MemryNote reloaded after a crash. Recent edits may be lost.

running.title: Moving your data
running.note: This happens once. Keep MemryNote open until it's done.

failed.title: Your data wasn't moved
failed.note: Nothing was lost. The previous MemryNote app and its data are unchanged.
failed.electronRunning: The previous MemryNote app is still open. Quit it, then try again.
failed.diskSpace: There isn't enough free disk space to move your data. Free some space, then try again.
failed.electronSchema: The previous MemryNote app hasn't finished updating a vault. Update that app, open the vault in it once, quit it, then try again.
failed.sharedStore: Some vaults share one sync history, so they can't be moved. Keep using the previous MemryNote app for them.
failed.vaultUnreachable: A vault can't be read right now. Check that its drive is connected, then try again.
failed.secrets: Some saved sign-in details couldn't be read. Try again. If it keeps happening, check that your keychain is unlocked.
failed.verification: A check of your moved data didn't pass, so MemryNote kept everything as it was.

completed.title: Your data moved to this version
completed.body: Your notes, settings and sign-in now live in this version of MemryNote. The previous app's data stays untouched at {path}.

notice.title: Changes made in the previous app
notice.body: A vault changed in the previous MemryNote app after it moved to this version. Those changes aren't here: they stay in the previous app's data at {path}. Changes that were synced arrive through sync.
